name: Walmart Over-the-Toilet Bathroom Space Saver Storage Cabinet
description: Maximize your bathroom storage and clear the countertop clutter with this classic white over-the-toilet space saver! Originally purchased from Walmart, this practical vertical shelving unit fits seamlessly over most standard toilet tanks to unlock valuable, underutilized vertical space. It features a spacious top display shelf, a handy middle double-door cabinet with sleek glass-style knobs to hide away private essentials or extra toilet paper rolls, and a convenient lower open shelf perfect for hair dryers, styling tools, or towels. A lightweight yet sturdy apartment essential that instantly elevates your bathroom organization!
contact_note: The unit is pre-assembled and ready to place in your bathroom, saving you from a tedious setup! It is lightweight and easy to carry, but please ensure your car can accommodate its 5.3-foot vertical height for pickup.
meta_description: Pre-owned white over-the-toilet bathroom storage space saver cabinet originally from Walmart. Features 2 open shelves and a double door middle cabinet in good condition.
name_zh: 沃尔玛 Walmart 购入马桶上方加高垂直收纳置物架/浴室太空舱柜
description_zh: 小户型、单身公寓及合租房浴室拓容的绝对救星！这款从沃尔玛购入的经典纯白马桶上方垂直置物架，能完美横跨绝大多数标准马桶水箱，把上方完全闲置的墙面变成巨大的收纳宝地。置物架最上方是一层开放式展示架；中间设计了带精致透明把手的双开门封闭储物柜，非常适合存放私密用品或备用卷纸；下方则是宽敞的开放隔板，用来放吹风机、直发棒或浴巾极其顺手。机身轻便且整体结构非常稳固，帮您彻底释放洗手台面空间。
